Hit-Boy Season is Live!

WELCOME TO BEAT BATTLE! 🎵🎧
Made by Overtune

A music-making platform & competitive remixing game
from Iceland with love

- REMIX unique tracks with loops! 🎶
- MAKE your own music using our Piano Roll 🎹
- BATTLE against your friends on stage! 🎤
- VOTE for your favourite performance! 🎆
- UNLOCK new DJ Decks, stages, effects! 💿
- EXPAND your music catalogue 🎵
- LEVEL up your production and climb the billboards! 🏆
- SHARE your best tracks with friends! ❤️

Please 👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVOURITE to support the game!
